references.text: The Lord will hand over the nations to Israel, and they shall devote them to destruction, as referred to in Deuteronomy 31:5.
Describes the command regarding how Israel is to treat the peoples of the promised land, the same command that is referenced here.
The Lord hands King Og over to Israel, an example of how the Lord gives enemies into Israel's hand.
Joshua receives the same promise that the Lord will be with him and hand the land over to Israel.
The Lord gives the Amorite kings into Joshua's hand, a fulfillment of the promise given through Moses.
The Lord had already handed King Og over to Moses, and Israel was to do to him as they had done to Sihon.
The Lord promises to hand over the inhabitants of the land to Israel, with the command not to make a covenant with them.
